left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Having mild  [OR] or moderate severity of AD
  -  Lack of communication difficulties  [OR] or problems
  -  Volunteering to participate in the study
  -  Cerebrovascular event,
  -  Having disturbing the balance  [OR] and coordination of neurological disease such as Parkinson, [OR]  MS,
  -  Mini Mental Test Score, 18 to 24 points from being scored
  -  being 65-80 aged

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients diagnosed with dementia (infection, [OR]  vascular, [OR]  hematological diseases), patients who could not be contacted during the follow-up period  [OR] or who did not come to control, cardiac  [OR] and cerebrovascular event,
  -  Endocrine disorder, [OR]  fluid-electrolyte imbalance  [OR] and infection
  -  Patients with malignancy  [OR] and malignancy, [OR]  chemotherapy  [OR] and radiotherapy,
  -  Patients with delirium  [OR] or depression
  -  Those with protective sensation loss (those with Semmes-Weinstein Monofilament Thickness 4

right.raw_text:
56 and above)
  -  patients with lower  [OR] or upper extremity amputations at any level
